mapper.insert: INSERT INTO product_reviews (order_id, user_id, product_id, product_name, product_image, rating, tag, content, images, status, is_deleted, created_at) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{userId}, #{productId}, #{productName}, #{productImage}, #{rating}, #{tag}, #{content}, #{images}, 1, 0, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, order_id, user_id, product_id, product_name, product_image, rating, tag, content, images, status, is_deleted, created_at, updated_at FROM product_reviews WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.sql: r.id, r.order_id, r.user_id, r.product_id, r.product_name, r.product_image, r.rating, r.tag, r.content, r.images, r.status, r.is_virtual, r.created_by, r.reply, r.reply_time, r.created_at, r.updated_at, o.order_no, u.name AS user_name, u.avatar AS user_avatar, a.name AS created_by_name
FROM product_reviews r LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.id = r.order_id LEFT JOIN `user` u ON u.id = r.user_id LEFT JOIN `admin` a ON a.id = r.created_by
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO product_reviews (order_id, user_id, product_id, product_name, product_image, rating, tag, content, images, status, is_deleted, is_virtual, created_by, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (0, 0, #{productId}, #{productName}, #{productImage}, #{rating}, #{tag}, #{content}, #{images}, 1, 0, 1, #{createdBy}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE product_reviews SET product_id = #{productId}, product_name = #{productName}, product_image = #{productImage}, rating = #{rating}, tag = #{tag}, content = #{content}, images = #{images}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0 AND is_virtual = 1
UPDATE product_reviews SET reply = #{reply}, reply_time = #{replyTime}, updated_at = #{replyTime} WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
UPDATE product_reviews SET status = #{status}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
UPDATE product_reviews SET is_deleted = 1, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.rating, r.tag, r.content, r.images, r.created_at, r.reply, r.reply_time, r.is_virtual, u.name AS user_name, u.avatar AS user_avatar FROM product_reviews r LEFT JOIN `user` u ON u.id = r.user_id WHERE r.product_id = #{productId} AND r.is_deleted = 0 AND r.status = 1 ORDER BY r.created_at DESC, r.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM product_reviews WHERE product_id = #{productId} AND is_deleted = 0 AND status = 1

SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalCount, COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(r.rating), 1), 0) AS avgRating, COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN r.rating >= 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 3), 0) AS goodRate, CAST(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.images IS NOT NULL AND r.images <> '' AND r.images <> '[]' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS SIGNED) AS withMediaCount, CAST(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.rating = 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS SIGNED) AS fiveStar, CAST(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.rating = 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS SIGNED) AS fourStar, CAST(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.rating = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS SIGNED) AS threeStar, CAST(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.rating = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS SIGNED) AS twoStar, CAST(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.rating = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS SIGNED) AS oneStar FROM product_reviews r WHERE r.product_id = #{productId} AND r.is_deleted = 0 AND r.status = 1
